messages:
Lena P.: Quick heads-up — I uploaded the consolidated benefits + handbook changes doc and scheduled a couple of mandatory microtraining drop-in sessions next week. RSVP here: https://redwood.docs/handbook/v3/benefits-update :spiral_calendar_pad:

Ben K.: Thanks — do managers need to acknowledge the changes or just direct reports?

Lena P.: Managers should acknowledge at the team level (one ack per manager). Individual contributors need to complete the 10-min microtraining and pass the quick quiz. Acks due by 2026-04-10.

Jamal S.: Is the microtraining going to be on the new parental/sick pay flow? We had a few edge cases in eng last quarter.

Lena P.: Yes — module 2 covers parental/sick pay changes + the updated FMLA integration notes. We added short examples for hourly contractors.

Maria G.: Will this be added to the new-hire checklist and offer pack? Hiring ops should include it before day 1.

Lena P.: Yes, Ori and I updated the onboarding checklist. Snippet we added to the offer/onboarding doc:

```
Onboarding checklist (required pre-day1):
- Send handbook v3 link
- Add microtraining enrollment to preboarding
- Confirm manager ack scheduled
```

Ori L.: Added to offers template & preboarding task list. Recruiting kickoff now includes a quick note to hiring managers.

HR-bot: Reminder scheduled: microtraining RSVP follow-up will go out 72 hours before each session (automated).

Ben K.: Cool. One more: any change to performance calibration timeline? Our IC reviews overlap with the training window.

Lena P.: We kept calibration dates unchanged — training window is intentionally flexible (multiple slots + recorded session). If a team needs a designated slot, ping me and I can reserve a private team session. :white_check_mark:

Jamal S.: Perfect, I'll book a team slot for May 6th.

Lena P.: Thanks — if anyone finds gaps in the examples (contractor or international leave scenarios), drop them here or open a doc comment. We'll iterate before the final handbook push. :memo:

Maria G.: Thanks, team — tagging hiring-ops folks to make sure templates propagate. :thumbsup:

Lena P.: Closing note: final ack/report will be exported for compliance on 2026-04-15. I'll post the summary CSV in #people-ops when ready.
